title: When you can can-can no longer #theatrenew #broadway #moulinrouge
transcript: In some sad Broadway news, Moulin Rouge is closing on July 26th of this year. This is quite a bit of notice, but for such a long running show, I'm glad that they have given everybody, cast, crew, and fans, a long time to go see it one last time on Broadway. Now, we do not know who's going to be part of the final cast. A lot of the current cast members are doing limited runs, including Bob the Drag Queen, only in it until March 22nd. So I imagine we'll get a last cast announcement soon. What an absolutely incredible run Moulin Rouge had. I thought this show was such a ton of fun and such a big spectacle on Broadway. And seven years is an absolutely incredible run for a musical. Right now, they do not have tickets on sale for the closing performance. You can get tickets for every other performance throughout the run. So I'm definitely curious to see if they're going to do, like, a special lottery for fans or if they're holding this for friends and family, similar to Phantom of the opera when it closed. Definitely sad to see this one go, and I may have to go see this one more time.
classificationReason: Creator discusses the closing announcement for Moulin Rouge on Broadway, including cast news and ticket information. While they share a fond personal opinion of the show generally, the video is closure news commentary, not a review of a specific attended performance of this production.
